paras: To ensure perfect fitment, our TRD V2 Style Rear Bumper Lip for Toyota 86 2012-2021 has been crafted from an ultra-high quality ABS Plastic which is moulded directly from the genuine version. This item compliments the rear profile of your car which aesthetically enhances the entire vehicles stance.

Please note, the unpainted variant is typically purchased with the intention to paint or wrap to match the colour of your car. All unpainted products will have blemishes from production as they are unfinished, and in their rawest state. Blemishes can include, but is not limited to, swirls, small scratches and marks from the moulding and production processes. We do not recommend fitting the item unpainted.
hl: 2017-2021 Toyota 86 Models. However, it will fit on 12-16 Toyota 86 and BRZ models with modification. For more details, please contact us.
